projectDescription: A self-correcting, schema-aware LangGraph agent that converts natural-language questions into validated, read-only SQL — powered by a local Ollama LLM, ChromaDB schema retrieval, and a FastAPI + React dashboard.
keyFeatures: Self-correcting 11-node LangGraph state machine with adaptive retry budgets
Schema-aware retrieval via ChromaDB with FK-adjacency bridge expansion
AST-based SQL validation (sqlglot) — SELECT-only allowlist, not keyword blocklist
Local LLM via Ollama — no cloud API keys required for SQL generation
Multi-database auto-routing across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and Oracle
Optional multi-source RAG: document/policy PDFs, live web search (Tavily), media generation, media search
Golden-dataset feedback loop — human-approved (question, SQL) pairs as few-shot examples
React dashboard with chart auto-pick, retry timeline, and schema browser
Voice mode — local faster-whisper STT and Piper TTS
Grounded insights verified against actual result data before display
publicApiSurface: POST /ask — run a natural-language question through the full agent graph
POST /execute — validate and execute a specific SQL string read-only
GET /health — reachability check for database, Ollama, and schema index
POST /schema/refresh — re-introspect and re-embed all database schemas
POST /feedback/golden-example — save a human-approved (question, SQL) pair
POST /generate/confirm — confirm and execute a media-generation proposal
POST /voice/transcribe — transcribe audio to text via local Whisper
POST /voice/synthesize — synthesize text to speech via local Piper
